name: RINDAX Lead Finder v2 — Linear, No Agent
description: A cost-optimization case study: replaces an earlier AI-agent-based lead finder (~$2.80 per test run due to token accumulation across tool calls) with a straight linear pipeline — 5 rotating local-business searches/day via a Maps search API, deduplicated against Airtable, one AI call per lead for outreach copy (~300 tokens) — cutting cost to roughly $0.0002/day for 10-15 leads (~99.9% cheaper).

nodes.name: Build Search Categories
nodes.notes: 15 predefined {query, niche, city} combinations across Indian cities and small-business niches (coaching centres, clinics, travel agents, photographers, micro agencies, salons/gyms, freelance consultants); rotates through 5 per day based on day-of-year so the same cities aren't searched every run

nodes.name: Extract Top 3 Places
nodes.notes: Keeps only businesses with a phone number or website, takes the top 3 results per search

nodes.name: Remove Duplicates
nodes.notes: Cross-checks new leads against existing Airtable company names and phone numbers before proceeding

nodes.name: Save Lead to Airtable
nodes.notes: Creates the record with Temperature=Warm, Status=New, and a Why Fit note built from the business's rating/review count

meta.security_note: API keys and bot tokens must be stored in n8n's credential manager rather than pasted directly into HTTP Request node headers.
